content.title: Records for every seed in March Madness from 1985 to 2025
content.text: These are records for all seeds in the NCAA DI men's basketball championship since it expanded to 64 teams in 1985, beginning with the first round/round of 64. The records are taken from the official guides at NCAA.org. Note that First Four records are not included, as these records reflect starting with the 64-team bracket. Not surprisingly, top seeds have by far the most wins with 534, along with the most titles with 26. Furthermore, seeds 1 through 6 are the only ones with winning records. Though No. 7 seeds have a winning record against 10 seeds — their first round foe — they lose to 10 seeds at a higher rate than they beat No. 2 or 15 seeds in the second round.
